entry.title: Pikmin 2 v0.8.0.post2
entry.content:
**NOTE: This mod is still in the testing phase. Play at your own risk.** **NOTE 2: Games generated on earlier versions will NOT work on this version.** **NOTE 3: Setup for this version is much different (and hopefully much simpler) than previous versions - please reread the setup guide before playing!** **NOTE 4: This release has been patched as of 8/27/26 at 1:49 PM UTC - please redownload if downloaded before then.**
## Changelog - Fix a bug that could cause generation to fail if multiple Pikmin 2 players were in a game (thank you KingDragonite for finding and fixing this) - Clarify the error message printed when the filler items dictionary is empty (thank you KingDragonite for finding and fixing this) - Completely rehaul the sending of items from the game to the client - The save file path is no longer needed - Linking now occurs at the title screen - Linking works from any file, not just the leftmost one - Linking works on Day 1 - Items can be received in menus and cutscenes (excluding the world map) - Most crashes (e.g., collecting the Utter Scrap location on Day 2) are fixed - **Memory Override is now required for the game to run properly** - This may be buggy on Linux; please let me know if you encounter any issues - Completely rehaul the progress restore so that the save file is not necessary - The duplicate item receipt bug should be permanently squashed - Enemy Randomizer and Boss + Enemy Randomizer now work on the overworld - May still have lingering issues - please report any crashes with this setting - Add new YAML option: Boss + Enemy Rando Locations - If either Enemy Randomizer or Boss + Enemy Randomizer is on, allows you to select which locations are randomized (cave, overworld, or both) - Change the game ID so it has a separate save file from vanilla Pikmin 2 - Remove the /force-relink command as it is deprecated - Add the total debt to the /status command output
Thanks to Sol for their help with tips on getting Memory Override to work, it made most of these features possible!
## Known Bugs - Queen Candypop Buds sometimes show up as white instead of red, even if you have Red Pikmin unlocked. This means that you can't use them to generate Red Pikmin, but you can use them to generate White Pikmin. - Whatever cave is in Submerged Castle's location will always have the vanilla Submerged Castle music. - Sometimes starting items will not be received properly, if this happens usually restarting the game and client causes them to appear - Sometimes the Pikmin can't break gates in caves. Usually resetting the cave fixes this. - Sometimes collecting Louie does not trigger the goal

entry.title: Zoominoes v0.1.0.post5
entry.content:
Community testing build. Feedback and bug reports welcome.
## Install
**1. BepInEx** — download **BepInEx 6 bleeding-edge, `Unity.Mono`, `win-x64`** from <https://builds.bepinex.dev/projects/bepinex_be> and unzip it into the game folder, next to `Zoominoes.exe`. Zoominoes is a Unity 6 Mono game; BepInEx 5 will not work. Run the game once so BepInEx creates its folders, then close it.
e.g. for Windows: <https://builds.bepinex.dev/projects/bepinex_be/785/BepInEx-Unity.Mono-win-x64-6.0.0-be.785%2B6abdba4.zip>
**2. The mod** — unzip `ZoominoesArchipelago.zip` into the same game folder. It drops into `BepInEx/plugins/`.
**3. The world** — put `zoominoes.apworld` in your Archipelago install's `custom_worlds/` folder.
On Linux the game runs under Proton with the same files. Add `WINEDLLOVERRIDES="winhttp=n,b" %command%` to the Steam launch options, or the loader will not inject.
## Playing
Press **F1** for the connection panel, enter your server address, port, slot name and password, and connect. The panel opens by itself until you do. Details are remembered for next launch.
Runs are played on a dedicated **AP** profile. Your existing saves are not read or written while the mod is installed.
## What is randomised
Animals, snacks, souvenirs, zookeepers and difficulty tiers arrive as Archipelago items, along with extra starting gold, extra plays and hand size.
`randomize_starter_zookeeper` and `randomize_starter_unlocks` extend that to what you open with: a random zookeeper in place of Marina, and a random 6 animals, 4 snacks and 4 souvenirs in place of Starfish, Fennec and the rest. Whatever the draw passes over becomes an item like anything else.
Checks come from Gift Shop slots and from finishing a day. **Every difficulty tier has its own set of both** — "Tier 3 - Shop 2 - Slot 1" is a different location from "Tier 5 - Shop 2 - Slot 1", so each tier you unlock opens 43 fresh checks: 24 across its eight shops and 19 across its playable days. On top of that, winning with each zookeeper and clearing each tier are checks in their own right.
Three goals: clear a target difficulty tier, clear it with several different zookeepers, or collect Zoo Tickets scattered across the multiworld.
Only normal runs take part — daily challenges, seeded runs and challenge runs are left alone.
Items apply from your **next** run, since the game fixes its content pool when a run begins.
## Options
`Zoominoes-template.yaml` has every option, its documentation and its weights. Put it in your Archipelago `Players` folder and change the name at the top.
Content the seed has no room for is unlocked from the start rather than left unobtainable.

entry.title: Dead Cells v0.1.8
entry.content:
New Features: - New biome warp system - In the tracker, when selecting a biome, a new button is present, allowing you to warp there - To warp to a biome, you need to have entered it at least once - You can only warp to biomes after your current one. This is determined by their world depth, which can be seen in the world map. - When selecting a biome to warp into, a button for canceling the warp appears. - The warp will be effective when exiting the menu
Gameplay Changes: - Restarting now also gives an aspect check - When selecting a 5 BSC goal, you can now only win by defeating the secret boss
Quality of Life: - Improved the in-game tracker - The missing requirements to access a biome are now shown on the biome image - The biome unlock item is represented by the lock in the top left corner - Item icons mean you should receive it, biome icons mean it is required to be accessible, and boss icons require you to have killed the boss - Requirements on the same line have an AND operator, an OR is applied between lines - Accessible biomes are now shown in the world map (thanks StudMuffin for the idea) - Added logic to the item tracker to show which items are accessible - You can select an item to show a pop-up with information on the item - The minimum number of BSC possible for this item - The mob dropping the blueprint, if any - Special requirements, if any, using the same display logic as biomes - A description for some items obtained in a specific way
Bug Fixes: - Starter items or items unlocked by default not being synced across saves after unlocking them at the Collector - A crash caused by some blueprints disappearing, such as the Half-Life ones and the Golden Outfits on DCCM 13.x - Gems replacing some picked blueprints not spawning - Items not being given and a rare minimap crash after quitting an existing save and then creating a new save on a new slot for another AP server without quitting the game - The Time Keeper’s portal for the glitched run - Giant cutscene playing when unlocking the King Outfit - King disappearing after unlocking the King Outfit, locking the Homunculus Rune and Symmetrical Lance locations - Interacting with the training room door without having the key, which allowed players to pass through the enter/exit door without checking any requirements - The selection speed of controllers in the mod UI, changing based on the monitor refresh rate. Its speed is the same as before for 60 fps - Improved responsiveness for UI text being smaller than expected - Improved responsiveness for scrollers having a smaller mask on resolutions other than 16:9
APWorld Changes: - Changed Luchador's Outfit rule, being accessible from the Bank - Added a missing Bank requirement for the Guillain Head - Added 3 missing Random Starter equipment rules for Blue Hole - Removed the Lizard Outfit from the Undying Shores logic - Added Swarm rule for Biter Head - Added 2 missing possible locations (Queen and Dracula) for BSC 1 to 4 - Added rules for locations at 5 BSC, such as Homunculus Rune for King Outfit, or Spider Rune for Sonic Carbine and for Observatory
Rayze's Changes: - Implemented "start_inventory_from_pool" - Added proper Option Groups - Outfits are now all filler unless they're expressly needed for something - Small rework to how generated filler is handled due to above ^ - Scrolls now have the "Useful" tag - Derelict Distillery (and the Cavern Key location) now don't generate on 0 BSC seeds, as they are "Post-Goal Locations" - Marked a handful of fitting "Progression" items with the new "Deprioritized" and "Skip Balancing" tags - Removed the now-unnecessary "Problem Heads" location group
Compatible with APWorld 0.1.7 and newer

entry.title: Fez v0.6.0
entry.content:
## What's Changed
- Added new Ability Randomizer option! - When enabled, the ability to carry (bombs, crates, etc) and turn objects (cranks, pivots) are locked behind checks - Change end goal configuration to allow any number of cubes from 32 to 64 - Fixes for a few cube checks - Parlor and Zu House QR anti-cube locations are now associated - QR code map cube is now supported and associated with Watertower Secret - Many bugfixes, stability improvements, and quality of life improvements - Item pickup detection is now much more reliable. Deviations in the item's position should no longer cause pickups to fail to be detected - Fix incorrect graphics for locked doors - Locked doors now update immediately when unlocked and no longer require reentering the room or using `reload`. Locked doors also turn into regular doors when unlocked rather than disappearing - Fix softlock when getting Emotional Support while the camera is spiraling down - Prevent Rotation Trap while in a flat room to prevent a softlock - Fix "Memory stream could not be expanded" - Show the HUD when you receive an item that changes your cube count instead of when you pick up an item - Fix 8 bit cube assemble animation happening if you have 7 bits and pick up a bit - Improve stability of `connect` and `disconnect` commands - Fix item spam after connecting - Fix incorrect number of cubes in the Hex Rebuild and wrong ending cutscene due to auto collection - Handle receiving collected locations (e.g. unlocked via auto collection or `/send_location`) - Any configuration that ends up with more items than available slots will now put filler items into your starting inventory to ensure all items are obtainable - The number of Golden Cubes that can be replaced with bits has been raised to 16 (the vanilla value) - When not shuffling clock antis, those locations are now fully removed from the game - Rename some doors to reduce confusion - "Tree Door Unlocked" -> "Tree Crumble Door Unlocked" - "Sewer Hub Door Unlocked" -> "Sewer QR Door Unlocked" - "Sewer Pillars Door Unlocked" -> "Sewer Fork Door Unlocked" - Compatibility with HAT 2.0
(Credit to @thearst3rd for compiling this list!)

The seed can be much longer now. Ruin Pool Size goes to 500 and Utility Count to 300, which takes a seed from around 355 checks to over a thousand. Ruins are the only setting that adds real content — every other location is carved out of the same item pool.
Fixed: pre_fill removed every trap and utility item from the pool but placed only as many as there were non-shop locations. Speed Boost Count is documented honestly: the game caps fast-forward at 300%, so 20 items is the maximum that does anything.
The engine is unchanged from v2.1.1.

entry.title: OpenTTD v2.2.0r2
entry.content:
Two questions this build can answer that the last one could not.
At session start the game now reports what the player can ACTUALLY build, by asking IsEngineBuildable for every engine — the same function the build window asks:
[AP] Buildable right now: 5 (trains=1 road=3 ships=0 aircraft=1) [AP] buildable engine ids: 15 132 219 253 345
And the five-second engine lock sweep now says when it takes something away, and how many engines it is protecting. That set lives only in memory and is never saved, so if it were ever empty during a session the sweep would quietly remove the player's whole fleet:
[AP] LockSweep: relocked N engine(s); AP-unlocked set holds M
The engine is otherwise unchanged from v2.1.2.

entry.title: OpenTTD v2.2.0r3
entry.content:
Received items are actually applied now. Every item London relayed arrived carrying only its id — the name field was empty — and the code gave up on an empty name instead of resolving the id through slot_data's item_id_to_name table. Measured in a live session: five shop purchases and three stars all registered on the server, the items all came back, and not one was applied. No engine in the build list, no ferry, and a Cash Injection £200,000 that never became money. The starting vehicles masked it, because they are granted on a different path.
An item that cannot be resolved is now said out loud in the console log instead of vanishing.
The window title tells the truth. The version stamp comes from a .ap_version file that overrides git and had said v2.0.4 since the 20th; the packer now refuses an engine whose stamp does not match the release.
If you load an existing save, your vehicles arrive on reconnect but already-consumed cash items do not — item replay skips consumables by design. Starting the seed's world fresh delivers everything, including the money.

entry.title: OpenTTD v2.3.0
entry.content:
The seed's settings are now locked once the world exists. Map size, economy, vehicle limits, station spread and forty-one other settings the seed decides were all still editable in the settings window during a session — and the change is saved, so it survived for the rest of the multiworld while the game quietly disagreed with everyone else's. All 45 are refused now, in SettingDesc::IsEditable, which every route to a setting goes through: the window greys the entry out, the console refuses, and a network client cannot push it either.
Maximum train length and station spread stop over-promising. The engine stores both in a uint8_t and its own table declares max 255 — already raised from vanilla's 64. The world offered up to 1000 and 1024, and those were silently clamped on arrival, so asking for a 1000-tile train got 255 with no warning anywhere. Both options now end at 255, which is what the engine can actually deliver.
Fast forward works again as a consequence of v2.1.4: Speed Boost is an item, and until items were applied at all it could never raise the limit.

entry.title: OpenTTD v2.4.0
entry.content:
Maps can be 4096x4096. That is the engine's own ceiling — map_type.h declares MAX_MAP_SIZE_BITS = 12, and the two axes are validated independently, so nothing stood in the way except the world only ever offering 2048. Sixteen point seven million tiles: generation takes minutes and the map alone wants gigabytes, so it is offered rather than recommended.
Known cost on a map that size: the God of Wackens punishment levels 4 and 5 walk every tile to find your rail. With Wrath enabled on 4096x4096 that is a visible pause each time he strikes. Ruins and stars are unaffected — they pick random tiles rather than scanning.

entry.title: MegaMan Battle Network 6 v0.2.0
entry.content:
# Beta - v0.2.0
> [!WARNING] > This has been tested and appears to be stable, but there could still be some unknown issues. Please save regularly, and report any bugs you encounter by opening up an issue, or via the Discord thread: https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1242860924092682481
- Game Page: [EN](https://github.com/RischDev/Archipelago/blob/main/worlds/mmbn6/docs/en_MegaMan%20Battle%20Network%206.md) - Setup Page: [EN](https://github.com/RischDev/Archipelago/blob/main/worlds/mmbn6/docs/setup_en.md)
Compatibility Notes - AP version: v0.6.7 - Other versions have not been tested at this time.
## Changelog **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/RischDev/Archipelago/compare/v0.1.1...v0.2.0
### New Features - ROMless generation has been added. Now, the host of a multiworld does not require the base Gregar or Falzar ROM in order to generate a world with BN6 in it. - Multiple requests can now be selected at a time. Requests will still be locked by your rank, but this means that you can immediately start all 11 one-star requests, and once you reach rank B, you can select all two-star requests. This prevents softlocks due to grabbing the wrong request. - Bass BX and ProtoMan FZ have been added as potential checks. This also adds ColForce Q and HubBatch J (vanilla rewards for Bass BX in Gregar and Falzar respectively) to the pool. - Added a Progressive Link Navi Item to the pool. Each world will generate with 4 copies of this item, which will upgrade all of the link navi's levels as they would normally due to story progression.
### Changes - Virus deletion counts will now start at 32. This means that once you get the BtlrCard, all rare viruses will become immediately available without additional grinding.
### Bug Fixes - VacData is now a requirement before beginning GroundMan class. When you talk to Moliarty, if you don't have VacData, he will inform you that it is required and will not let you start the class. This prevents potential softlocks.
## Status - ROMless generation has been added via APProcedurePatch - Gregar and Falzar both supported - Upcoming Features: - Virus randomization. - New checks like ProtoMan and other link navi fights. - Optional goals, like Bass, Bass SP, Bass BX, Beast SP, or ProtoMan FZ.
### Checks - Base pool: 297 - Settings: - Request Rewards: 38 - EX Bosses: 6 - SP Bosses: 6 - Graveyard checks: 8 - Virus Battler checks: 5 - Bass BX: 1 - ProtoMan FZ: 1 - Total with all exclusions: 232 - Locations per region (all options enabled): - Central Town: 105 - Central Internet: 10 - Central 3/Underground: 11 - Seaside Town: 34 - Seaside Internet: 17 - Green Town: 21 - Green Internet: 17 - Sky Town: 31 - Sky Internet: 15 - ACDC Town: 3 - ACDC Internet: 6 - Undernet: 7 - Graveyard: 8 - Expo Site: 12
## Known Issues - The client is required for certain location checks (specifically EX and SP bosses) to give items, and is required to set flags when receiving Crosses, BeastOut, and BtlrCard items. As such, playing offline will not fully work, so players cannot play on console for single player games yet, and you must be connected to the client to fully experience the game. - Skipping a cutscene that can give an item (such as after Link Navi classes or after Bass/Bass SP) can result in not receiving a local item. The location check will still be sent, but if it's a local item, it will need to be received via a `/send` command. Try to avoid skipping these cutscenes until after you see the `get item` textbox. - Certain checks that could theoretically scout their contents (such as WWW ID and BtlrCard navis) are not currently scoutable locations. As such, before buying the items, they will display the wrong item. - Fighting Bass always gives the BatKey, even if it is located elsewhere. You can still get the randomized item from this location (don't skip the cutscene for local items), but you will get BatKey as well. - Fighting Bass SP will always give the version-specific giga chip.You can still get the randomized item from this location (don't skip the cutscene for local items), but you will get the giga chip as well. - The puddle to Seaside Area from Central 3 is not a 2-way obstacle. As such, you can go from Seaside into Central 3 even without `ToolPrgm`, but you can't go from Central 3 to Seaside without it. - `AreaPass` does give access to ACDC Area, but the invisible obstacle can only be cleared during the right chapter of the story. You need to trigger the dialogue, then you can enter a menu and close it to re-load the map and clear the obstacle. - Request Points will still display the wrong number of request points under certain circumstances. However, the patch will correctly calculate the appropriate number of request points based on the completion flags, so this can be safely ignored.
## Other info For a full list of area requirements of requests, you can reference this [Pastebin](https://pastebin.com/nmb1a562)
